description: Inspect and run an external MoCapAnything V2 environment for video-to-BVH motion capture; requires separate torch/model weights, and inference passes only on a zero exit plus expected artifact.
checks: repository, Python, torch and checkpoint presence are probed honestly
config must be a repository-local YAML file
inference passes only when the command exits 0 and an expected artifact exists if requested
BVH validation checks HIERARCHY/MOTION, joints, frame count and SHA-256
no automatic retarget into Gypsy/Godot/Unity is claimed
